notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.

goFirst: strategy-concepts §10 [S17] 'go second with removal, late-game and counter-heavy decks' and the general default is to go second; the guide calls the deck midrange and gives no seat advice (inference). Seat does not decide the DON!! condition of P-093 and EB04-038 ('as few DON!! as your opponent or fewer' [CARD]): at the start of its own turn each side has one more DON!! than the other's last turn left it, so only the leader's DON!! -1 brings the count level.

cardValue: Laws are the deck's plan and the leader protects them [SH-ROS][CARD]; EB04-038 counts as a [Trafalgar Law] and a [Donquixote Rosinante], so the discount and the shield both reach it [CARD]; Borsalino refills Life [CARD]. Every number is an inference.
weights.don 0.9: the plan spends DON!! -1 on the discount and on On Plays, and two Laws refund it [CARD]; inference: a spent DON!! costs a little less.
counterAggression 1.05: each shield costs a Life card from a 4-Life leader (guide, weak to Life pressure, inference).
faceBias 0.95/1.0/1.1: a midrange deck that closes with removal and Laws [SH-ROS]; inference.

mulligan: the guide gives no sourced baseline. Its inference: a 1-cost searcher plus a 4-cost Law or EB04-038 (going first); going second 'a hand with a Law and no searcher is fine', so one piece may be short; no searcher and no Law goes back.

seed 1: 'activateBefore' (new bias kind): the leader's DON!! -1 discount before a Law of cost 4 or more, only when it refunds itself (P-093, EB04-038, condition met after DON!! -1) or is the only way to play the Law [SH-ROS step 3][CARD]; an unconditional discount lost games (DECISIONS 2026-11-17); not cited when activated (its reason, a Law in hand, is hidden), cited when the Law is played after it. seed 2: 'play' on the Laws by T3. seed 3: 'acceptOptional' with 'minLife' 2 on the shield. seed 4: 'avoidTarget' (new bias kind) on Sakazuki, Gum-Gum Lightning and Divine Departure. seed 5: no bias of its own; the discount's DON!! -1 (seed 1) brings the count level with the opponent's, which is what the guide says it is for [CARD].
Citations are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; every bias here has a public condition.

assertions.text: Uses the leader's discount before a [Trafalgar Law]-named card of cost 4 or more when the discount refunds itself (the Law's DON!! condition will be met after DON!! -1: P-093, EB04-038) or is the only way to play that Law this turn; otherwise plays it without the discount. At least 90% of such plays.
assertions.source: SH-ROS step 3; leader text [CARD]; inference from card text and measured self-play (DECISIONS 2026-11-17)

assertions.text: Has at least one [Trafalgar Law] Character on the field by the end of T3 in at least 60% of games.
Uses the leader's replacement when a Law would be K.O.'d and Life is 2 or more in at least 90% of eligible K.O.s.
At most 20% of Sakazuki, Gum-Gum Lightning and Divine Departure targets are Characters with cost 2 or less.
assertions.source: SH-ROS 'Hold Purple removal for real threats'

assertions.text: P-093 and EB04-038 are played with their DON!! condition (own DON!! at or below the opponent's) met in at least 70% of plays, judged when the leader's DON!! -1 can level the count (the turn began at most one DON!! above the opponent's).
